These bored members of the upper classes wage war from mobile fortresses and view the battlefield as their playground. Few in number, the Titan Lords usually offer their services as mercenaries, but on the rare occasions when they fight together, their armies of massive walkers are a spectacle to behold. With little fear of consequences for their actions, Titan Lords often wander from one battlefield to the next, seeking some sort of thrill or purpose that is lacking in their pampered lives. Within a relatively short time, humanity has managed to build up a large industrial base in their colonies throughout the Sirius Sector, and most of these are owned by a handful of powerful companies.... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/titan-lords) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Plaguebound: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. ### Special Rules Delayed Action: Once per round, if your opponent has more units left to activate than you, then this model's unit may pass its turn instead of activating (may still be activated later). Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). ### Aura Special Rules Read more ### Spells Aura of Pestilence (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which counts as being in Difficult Terrain once (next time the effect would apply). Rapid Putrefaction (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Surge. Blessed Virus (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Rapid Rush once (next time the effect would apply). Plague Malediction (2): Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 2 hits with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. Plague Boon (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Plaguebound Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Rot Wave (3): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 6 hits. ### Units ### Vehicles / Monsters Plague Vassal Micro-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 200pts Heavy Hammer(A1, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A3, AP(1)) Fear(1), Fortified, Plaguebound, Tough(9) Plague Errant Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 300pts Heavy Hammer(A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Fortified, Furious, Plaguebound, Tough(12) Plague Pilgrim Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 365pts Fusion Blaster(24", A1, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Fortified, Plaguebound, Tough(12) Plague Yeoman Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 460pts 2x Fusion Blaster(24", A1, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Plaguebound, Relentless, Tough(12) ### Titans Plague Paladin Light Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 500pts Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Heavy Hammer(A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A6, AP(2)) Fear(3), Fortified, Plaguebound, Tough(18) Plague Questor Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 720pts Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)), Titan Hammer(A4, AP(1), Blast(3)) Fear(4), Fortified, Furious, Plaguebound, Tough(24) Plague Knight Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 850pts Titan Fusion Cannon(24", A2, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)) Fear(4), Fortified, Plaguebound, Tough(24) Plague Duke Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 1040pts 2x Titan Fusion Cannon(24", A2, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)) Fear(4), Plaguebound, Relentless, Tough(24) Plague King Heavy Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 1135pts Twin Shoulder-Cannon(24", A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), 2x Titan Harpoon Cannon(18", A1, AP(4), Deadly(9)), Twin Hull-Fuser(12", A2, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A10, AP(3)) Fear(4), Plaguebound, Tough(30) Images: -
